Workshop services

Ironwork and welding in Riyadh

Our Riyadh workshop makes custom iron doors, gates, fences, stair railings and window grilles for villas and commercial properties. Each piece is measured for the site, welded in the workshop and finished for its intended setting.

Materials and finish

Specifications and options

What affects the price of custom ironwork?

Length, steel section, ornament and finish all affect the work involved. For a fence, give the total run and entrance width separately. If the entrance needs a motor, compare automatic and manual gate options and specify how you want it to open.

  • Iron treated for rust resistance.
  • Specialist welding of joints and frames.
  • Weather-resistant finishes.
  • Traditional Saudi patterns and contemporary designs.
  • Gate automation options.
  • Workmanship warranty and periodic maintenance.
From survey to installation

How we work

  1. 01

    Site survey

    We measure the entrance, boundary or staircase.

  2. 02

    Design

    We agree the profile, decorative details and finish with you.

  3. 03

    Fabrication and welding

    The workshop cuts, shapes and welds the iron to size.

  4. 04

    Installation and painting

    We secure the piece, complete the paintwork and adjust moving parts.
